annotations.title: AI Bot Log Telemetry, WAF Spoofing & Analytics Attribution

description: Analyze domain-level server log bot-hit telemetry, edge WAF bot-spoofing behavior, and AI referral attribution across Model Training Crawlers, AI Search Indexers, and User-Triggered Agent Browsers (distinct from 'technical_seo_crawl', which inspects single-page HTML DOM and HTTP headers). Use this tool to detect Cloudflare or AWS WAF rules blocking legitimate AI search bots on 'domain' and to generate referral attribution regex filters for your 'analytics_platform'. Returns 3-tier bot telemetry classifications, edge WAF spoofing diagnostics, and ready-to-paste GA4, Plausible, PostHog, and Nginx regex rules.

analytics_platform.description: Target analytics platform for generated referral attribution regex snippets (default: "all").

domain.description: Target root domain to audit AI bot log telemetry, WAF spoofing, and referral attribution rules for (e.g., "argosor.com").
